title: Perspective Dial: Measuring Perspective of Text and Guiding LLM Outputs

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying perspective using a metric space trained via contrastive learning with a BERT-based Siamese network on opinion pieces from the 2024 US Presidential Election, clustered into left-leaning, right-leaning, and center viewpoints.

Quantifying text perspective using a metric space trained via contrastive learning with a BERT-based Siamese network on Quora posts, clustered into Pro-Real Madrid, Pro-Barcelona, and neutral fan viewpoints.
